# Test: grove switch shell-init --shell powershell generates PowerShell function
setup_workspace

exec grove switch shell-init --shell powershell
stdout 'grove.exe switch'
stdout 'Set-Location'
stdout '\$env:GROVE_SHELL = "1"'
stdout 'finally'
stdout 'Remove-Item Env:GROVE_SHELL'
stdout 'GROVE_PREV_WORKTREE'
stdout 'no previous worktree'
stdout 'grove.exe remove'
! stderr .
